# Osborne Electric & Contracting

> Family-owned, licensed electrical contractor based in Bluffdale, Utah, serving Salt Lake, Utah, Davis, Tooele and Summit Counties. Residential, commercial and industrial electrical work with a Master Electrician on every job. Phone (801) 885-4521.

## Company
- Legal entity: Osborne Electric and Contracting, LLC
- Based in: Bluffdale, Utah (service-area business; no walk-in address)
- Phone: (801) 885-4521
- Email: Osborne-electric@outlook.com
- Company contractor licence: Utah DOPL #12644476-5501
- Wes Osborne: Master Electrician, Utah #8528070-5502 (master electrician of record)
- Trevor Osborne: General Building Contractor, Utah B100 #9015139-B100
- Fully insured; free estimates

## Services
- Residential electrical services
- Electrical panel upgrades
- Lighting installation
- Power restoration
- Remodels and new-construction wiring
- EV charger installation
- Whole-home rewiring
- Generator installation
- Emergency electrician
- Hot tub and spa wiring
- Commercial electrical
- Industrial and warehouse electrical
- Data and low-voltage wiring

## Service area
- Salt Lake County, Utah

- Davis County, Utah
